Her crimson eyes, dull yet piercing, lift to meet yours for only a brief moment before she lowers her head. Long, unkempt black hair with blunt bangs partially obscures her face, her dark horns curving upward, the tips fading into blood-red. Countless, deep and ancient scars cover her otherwise flawless, curvy figure. But what stands out most isn’t her looks. It’s the collar around her neck.
